spec.title: Requests
spec.description: HTTP requests Groundwave served in the selected range.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | event="request" [$__range])) or vector(0)

spec.title: Denied
spec.description: Requests rejected before being served, across all reasons.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | event="access_denied" [$__range])) or vector(0)

spec.title: Denied share
spec.description: Share of all inbound requests that were denied. Routinely high here: most denials are the proof-of-work gate doing its job.

spec.expr: 100 * sum(count_over_time({nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | event="access_denied" [$__range])) / sum(count_over_time({nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | source_extracted="web_request" | event=~"request|access_denied" [$__range]))

spec.title: p95 latency
spec.description: 95th percentile request handling time. by () keeps the unwrap from fanning out over every path and IP, which trips Loki's 500-series limit.

spec.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | source_extracted="web_request" | event="request" | unwrap duration_ms [$__range]) by () or vector(0)

spec.title: Errors logged
spec.description: Lines at level=error from any Groundwave subsystem.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | level="error" [$__range])) or vector(0)

spec.title: Request rate by status class
spec.description: Responses per 5 minutes grouped into 2xx/3xx/4xx/5xx.

spec.expr: sum by (status_class) (count_over_time({nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | source_extracted="web_request" | event="request" | label_format status_class=`{{ printf "%.1sxx" .status }}` [5m]))

spec.title: Log volume by source
spec.description: Lines per 5 minutes from each logging source. whatsapp dominates by an order of magnitude and is mostly protocol debug.

spec.expr: sum by (source_extracted) (count_over_time({nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt [5m]))

spec.title: Top paths
spec.description: Most requested paths in the selected range.

spec.expr: topk(15, sum by (path) (count_over_time({nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | source_extracted="web_request" | event="request" [$__range])))

spec.title: Errors and warnings
spec.description: Every warn/error line, newest first.

spec.expr: {nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | level=~"error|warn"

spec.title: Requests by status
spec.description: Response codes per 5 minutes.

spec.expr: sum by (status) (count_over_time({nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | source_extracted="web_request" | event="request" [5m]))

spec.title: Status codes
spec.description: Response code mix over the selected range.

spec.expr: sum by (status) (count_over_time({nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | source_extracted="web_request" | event="request" [$__range]))

spec.title: Latency quantiles
spec.description: Request handling time per 5 minutes at the 50th, 95th and 99th percentile.

spec.expr: quantile_over_time(0.50, {nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | source_extracted="web_request" | event="request" | unwrap duration_ms [5m]) by ()
quantile_over_time(0.95, {nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | source_extracted="web_request" | event="request" | unwrap duration_ms [5m]) by ()
quantile_over_time(0.99, {nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | source_extracted="web_request" | event="request" | unwrap duration_ms [5m]) by ()

spec.title: Requests by method
spec.description: HTTP verb mix.

spec.expr: sum by (method) (count_over_time({nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | source_extracted="web_request" | event="request" [$__range]))

spec.title: Slowest paths (p95)
spec.description: Paths with the highest 95th percentile handling time.

spec.expr: topk(15, quantile_over_time(0.95, {nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | source_extracted="web_request" | event="request" | unwrap duration_ms [$__range]) by (path))

spec.title: Top client IPs
spec.description: Busiest source addresses in the selected range.

spec.expr: topk(20, sum by (ip) (count_over_time({nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | source_extracted="web_request" | event="request" [$__range])))

spec.title: Authenticated vs anonymous
spec.description: Requests carrying a valid session versus not.

spec.expr: sum by (authenticated) (count_over_time({nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | source_extracted="web_request" | event="request" [5m]))

spec.title: Blocked requests
spec.description: Requests carrying a block_reason — IP block list, ASN block or country rule.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | source_extracted="web_request" | block_reason!="" [$__range])) or vector(0)

spec.title: PoW verify failures
spec.description: Proof-of-work challenges submitted but rejected. A sustained rise means someone is attacking the challenge rather than solving it.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | event="pow_verify_failed" [$__range])) or vector(0)

spec.title: Hard-risk requests
spec.description: Requests from ASNs scored high risk, which get the hardest proof-of-work challenge.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | source_extracted="web_request" | asn_risk="hard" [$__range])) or vector(0)

spec.title: Denials by reason
spec.description: access_denied events per 5 minutes, split by reason.

spec.expr: sum by (reason) (count_over_time({nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | event="access_denied" [5m]))

spec.title: Proof-of-work state
spec.description: Requests per 5 minutes by whether the session had solved the challenge. skipped covers exempt and static paths.

spec.expr: sum by (pow) (count_over_time({nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | source_extracted="web_request" | pow!="" [5m]))

spec.title: Block reason
spec.description: Which block list rejected the request.

spec.expr: sum by (block_reason) (count_over_time({nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | source_extracted="web_request" | block_reason!="" [$__range]))

spec.title: ASN risk mix
spec.description: Risk score assigned to the source network.

spec.expr: sum by (asn_risk) (count_over_time({nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | source_extracted="web_request" | asn_risk!="" [$__range]))

spec.title: Access policy applied
spec.description: Challenge tier each request was served.

spec.expr: sum by (access_policy) (count_over_time({nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | source_extracted="web_request" | access_policy!="" [$__range]))

spec.title: Top blocked IPs
spec.description: Addresses hitting a block rule most often.

spec.expr: topk(20, sum by (ip, block_reason) (count_over_time({nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | source_extracted="web_request" | block_reason!="" [$__range])))

spec.title: Denied requests
spec.description: Raw access_denied lines, newest first.

spec.expr: {nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | event="access_denied" | line_format `{{.status}} {{.method}} {{.path}}  ·  {{.reason}}  ·  ip={{.ip}}  ·  risk={{.asn_risk}}`

spec.title: Contact submissions
spec.description: Contact form submissions in the selected range.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | event="contact_form_submission" [$__range])) or vector(0)

spec.title: Break-glass sessions
spec.description: Completed break-glass unlocks. Any non-zero value here should correspond to something you did.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | source_extracted="web_request" | path="/break-glass/finish" | status="200" [$__range])) or vector(0)

spec.title: Failed logins
spec.description: 401 and 403 responses on the login and webauthn endpoints.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | source_extracted="web_request" | path=~"/(login|webauthn)(/.*)?" | status=~"401|403" [$__range])) or vector(0)

spec.title: Submissions over time
spec.description: Contact form submissions per hour.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | event="contact_form_submission" [1h])) or vector(0)

spec.title: Auth endpoint activity
spec.description: Requests to login, webauthn and break-glass endpoints per 30 minutes, by path and response code.

spec.expr: sum by (path, status) (count_over_time({nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | source_extracted="web_request" | path=~"/(break-glass|login|webauthn)(/.*)?" [30m]))

spec.title: Submission log
spec.description: Who submitted the contact form, with the details they left.

spec.expr: {nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | event="contact_form_submission" | line_format `{{.full_name}} <{{.email}}>  ·  ip={{.ip}}`

spec.title: Auth log
spec.description: Requests against the authentication and proof-of-work endpoints.

spec.expr: {nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | source_extracted="web_request" | path=~"/(break-glass|login|webauthn|pow)(/.*)?" | line_format `{{.status}} {{.method}} {{.path}}  ·  ip={{.ip}}  ·  auth={{.authenticated}}`

spec.title: Database errors
spec.description: level=error lines from the db subsystem.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | source_extracted="db" | level="error" [$__range])) or vector(0)

spec.title: WhatsApp errors
spec.description: level=error lines from the WhatsApp bridge.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | source_extracted="whatsapp" | level="error" [$__range])) or vector(0)

spec.title: App errors
spec.description: level=error lines from the application core and MCP server.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | source_extracted=~"app|web|mcp" | level="error" [$__range])) or vector(0)

spec.title: Backend log rate by level
spec.description: Non-request subsystems (db, whatsapp, app, mcp) per 5 minutes, by severity.

spec.expr: sum by (level) (count_over_time({nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | source_extracted=~"db|whatsapp|app|mcp" [5m]))

spec.title: WhatsApp activity by level
spec.description: The bridge is the loudest source by far; debug is whatsmeow protocol chatter and is normal.

spec.expr: sum by (level) (count_over_time({nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | source_extracted="whatsapp" [5m]))

spec.title: Backend errors
spec.description: warn and error lines from every non-request subsystem.

spec.expr: {nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | source_extracted=~"db|whatsapp|app|mcp" | level=~"error|warn"

spec.title: All Groundwave logs
spec.description: Full log stream. Narrow it with the Source and Level pickers above, or add ad-hoc field filters.

spec.expr: {nodename="oreamnos", source="groundwave.service"} | logfmt | source_extracted=~"${source:regex}" | level=~"${level:regex}"

spec.name: source
spec.label: Source
spec.description: Groundwave logging source, from the logfmt source field. Loki renames it source_extracted because the journal stream already carries a source label.

spec.name: level
spec.label: Level
spec.description: Log severity. Filters the Logs tab only.
